panels.title: 기기별 최신 값

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(time) AS "마지막 기록", site AS "지역", protocol AS "프로토콜", room AS "방", device AS "기기",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'temperature') AS "온도",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'humidity') AS "습도",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'presence') AS "재실",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'contact') AS "닫힘",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'illuminance') AS "조도",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'carbon_dioxide') AS "CO2",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'pm25') AS "PM2.5",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'battery') AS "배터리",
  last(value, time) FILTER (WHERE property = 'linkquality') AS "LQI"
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND protocol IN ($protocol) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device))
GROUP BY site, protocol, room, device
ORDER BY site, protocol, room, device

panels.description: 선택한 기간에서 기기마다 속성별 마지막 값입니다. 재실·닫힘은 1/0 입니다.

GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 실물 기기

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(time) AS "마지막 기록", site AS "지역", protocol AS "프로토콜", source AS "수집기", hw_id AS "실물 ID",
  model AS "모델", vendor AS "제조사", last(node, time) AS "Matter 노드 ID",
  last(device, time) AS "현재 이름", string_agg(DISTINCT device, ', ') AS "쓴 이름", count(DISTINCT property) AS "속성 수"
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND protocol IN ($protocol) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND hw_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY site, protocol, source, hw_id, model, vendor
ORDER BY site, protocol, 9

panels.description: 실물 기기별 정보입니다. 실물 ID 는 Zigbee IEEE 주소나 Matter 시리얼로, 기기 이름을 바꾸거나 다시 페어링해도 바뀌지 않습니다. Matter 노드 ID 는 다시 커미셔닝하면 바뀝니다.

panels.title: 최근 기록

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, site, protocol, source, room, device, replace(property, 'pm25', 'pm2.5') AS property, value, value_text, hw_id
FROM readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND site IN ($site) AND protocol IN ($protocol) AND ('__all__' IN ($room) OR room IN ($room)) AND ('__all__' IN ($device) OR device IN ($device)) AND ('__all__' IN ($property) OR property IN ($property))
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.description: 선택한 기간의 원본 행 최근 200개입니다. 속성 변수로 거를 수 있습니다.
